summary: Unified S3-family backend serving AWS S3, S3 Express, R2, MinIO, and B2 via flavor-dispatched connection. Composed from 7 mixins (Connection, Read, Write, List, Delete, Metadata, Copy). Registered under 5 provider types. Backwards-compatible aliases (R2StorageBackend, etc.) exported. Uses boto3 internally.
extension_points: Flavor dispatch in S3ConnectionMixin controls endpoint/region for new S3-compatible services
lifecycle_notes: Phase 4: consolidated 5 separate backend classes into one with flavor dispatch
S3ConnectionMixin supports 3 auth_params shapes (profile, legacy wrapper, None)
risks: read_to_stream wraps bytes in BytesIO rather than streaming from S3 body — memory concern for large objects
